metadata.title: AI Character Studio | joymagic
metadata.description: Design consistent AI characters with a dark editorial workspace built for stills, motion, and reusable character systems.
metadata.keywords: AI character, character creator, AI avatar studio, character design, consistent character generation

title: Build a character world that stays consistent across images, video, and motion.
description: Inspired by editorial creator tools but adapted to joymagic, this page frames character creation as a visual system: start from one identity, explore ready-made directions, then branch into portraits, motion clips, and reusable assets without losing the core look.
createCardDescription: Start from one face, one mood, or one mascot and turn it into a reusable character system.
browseCardDescription: Pick from polished starter directions built for portraits, motion, and branded content.
quickStartsDescription: Fast entry points for the most common character production flows in joymagic.
libraryDescription: Mix style locking, expression studies, motion tests, and export presets to shape one recognizable character universe.
stageTitle: Create amazing character content in minutes.
stageDescription: Use one visual identity as the source of truth, then generate stills, loops, posters, and expressive variants that already feel like they belong together.
spotlightDescription: The layout keeps the playful, premium feel of the reference while grounding it in real joymagic use cases.
workflowDescription: Move from a raw idea to a production-ready character pack without context switching.

spotlightItems.title: One identity, many outputs
spotlightItems.description: Lock the face, palette, styling cues, and silhouette before expanding into posters, social visuals, and short-form motion.

spotlightItems.title: Preview-led exploration
spotlightItems.description: The stage area foregrounds the creative result first, so users understand what they are building before they touch a workflow.

spotlightItems.title: Fast handoff to tools
spotlightItems.description: Primary actions point naturally into image creation flows, making the page feel connected to the rest of the product instead of isolated.

workflowSteps.title: Seed the identity
workflowSteps.description: Start with a portrait, mascot, or moodboard and define the non-negotiable traits that make the character recognizable.

workflowSteps.title: Choose a starter lane
workflowSteps.description: Jump into portrait, video, talking avatar, or motion tests using quick starts tuned for common creation paths.

workflowSteps.title: Generate consistent variants
workflowSteps.description: Use the same references and prompts to produce stills and clips that preserve the character system instead of drifting visually.

workflowSteps.title: Ship the pack
workflowSteps.description: Export assets for covers, shorts, product storytelling, or social series from one shared creative source.
